page.overview:
Who is Hamaki Mimura?

During the Third Shinobi World War, Hamaki's battalion was reduced to a mere four shinobi by their Iwagakure opponents; however, when all apparent hope was seemingly lost, Minato Namikaze arrived. He briefed Minato on the situation and then he, and the other three shinobi, subsequently helped Minato wipe out about fifty opposing Iwa-nin by throwing his Flying Thunder God Kunai behind enemy lines.

Hamaki has short dark hair and a beard. He wears the standard attire of the Konoha shinobi inclusive of flak jacket, and forehead protector that he wears like a bandanna along with a pair of fingerless gloves. He also carries a tantō strapped to his lower back.

Hamaki was presumably a very powerful shinobi considering he was one of the final four survivors from fighting an army of fifty Iwa shinobi. The fact that he carries a sword, implies that he is skilled in kenjutsu.
